title.en: Math Kangaroo 2016 – Level B -1 Q1: Largest Dice Total
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2016 – Level B -1 第1题：骰子点数最大

content.en: Amy, Bert, Carl, Doris and Ernst each rolled two dice and added the number of dots. Who rolled the largest total?
content.zh: Amy、Bert、Carl、Doris 和 Ernst 各掷了两颗骰子并把点数相加。谁的点数之和最大？

explanation.en: Dice totals: Amy 7, Bert 6, Carl 5, Doris 8, Ernst 9. Ernst is largest.

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2016 – Level B -1 Q2: Kanga Turns 8 Weeks
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2016 – Level B -1 第2题：小袋鼠满八周

content.en: Small Kanga is 7 weeks and 2 days old. In how many days will he be 8 weeks old?
content.zh: 小 Kanga 现在 7 个星期又 2 天大。再过多少天他会满 8 个星期？

explanation.en: 8 weeks = 7 weeks + 7 days; already 2 days into the week ⇒ 5 days left.
explanation.zh: 8 周=7 周+7 天；已过 2 天，还差 5 天。

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2016 – Level B -1 Q3: Arrow Number Puzzle
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2016 – Level B -1 第3题：箭头算式求值

content.en: Follow the arrows in the diagram. What number replaces the question mark?
content.zh: 按图中箭头运算。问号处应填什么数？

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2016 – Level B -1 Q4: Pipo in the Mirror
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2016 – Level B -1 第4题：Pipo 照镜子

content.en: What does Pipo see when he looks at himself in the mirror?
content.zh: Pipo 照镜子时将看见什么？

explanation.en: A mirror flips left and right; only option A matches the reflection.
explanation.zh: 镜子左右翻转，只有 A 与镜像一致。

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2016 – Level B -1 Q5: Circus Seat Direction
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2016 – Level B -1 第5题：马戏团座位方向

content.en: Geoff goes with his father to a circus. Their seats are numbered 71 and 72. Which way should they go?
content.zh: Geoff 和他爸爸去马戏团，座位编号是 71 和 72。他们应向哪个方向走？

explanation.en: Seats 71–72 fall in the 61–80 range, which points diagonally up-right.
explanation.zh: 71、72 属于 61–80，对应斜向上右箭头。

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2016 – Level B -1 Q6: Sharing Half Apples
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2016 – Level B -1 第6题：分享半个苹果

content.en: Anna shares some apples between herself and 5 friends (6 people total). Everyone gets half an apple. How many apples does she share?
content.zh: Anna 与 5 位朋友（共 6 人）分享苹果，每人半个。她一共分享了多少个苹果？

explanation.zh: 6 人×半个苹果=3 个苹果。

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2016 – Level B -1 Q7: Hidden Behind Curtain
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2016 – Level B -1 第7题：窗帘后的形状

content.en: A rectangle is partly hidden behind a curtain. What shape is the hidden part?
content.zh: 一个长方形的一部分藏在窗帘后面。被隐藏的部分是什么形状？

explanation.en: The visible cut shows the hidden part is a triangle.
explanation.zh: 从露出的切口可判断隐藏部分是三角形。

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2016 – Level B -1 Q8: Year Digit Sum 9
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2016 – Level B -1 第8题：年份数字和为9

content.en: The digit sum of 2016 is 2+0+1+6=9. What is the nearest year after 2016 whose digits also sum to 9?
content.zh: 2016 的数字之和为 9。2016 年之后，下一个数字之和同样为 9 的最近年份是哪一年？

explanation.en: After 2016, the nearest year with digit sum 9 is 2025 (2+0+2+5=9).
explanation.zh: 2016 之后最近数字和为 9 的是 2025。

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2016 – Level B -1 Q9: Mouse Maze Paths
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2016 – Level B -1 第9题：老鼠迷宫路线

content.en: The mouse wants to escape from the maze. How many different paths can it take without passing through the same gate more than once?
content.zh: 老鼠想逃出迷宫。在不经过同一扇门超过一次的情况下，有几条逃脱路线？

explanation.en: Counting gate-paths without reuse gives 4 routes.
explanation.zh: 不重复过门，共有 4 条路线。

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2016 – Level B -1 Q10: Zoe’s Hidden Numbers
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2016 – Level B -1 第10题：Zoe 卡上的数字

content.en: Zoe has two cards with a number on each side. The two side-sums are equal; the four numbers sum to 32. What could the two hidden numbers be?
content.zh: Zoe 有两张卡，每面一个数。两张卡各自两面之和相等，四个数之和为 32。看不见的两面可能是哪两个数？

explanation.en: Each card sums to 16. Visible numbers force the hidden pair 11 & 4.
explanation.zh: 每张卡和为 16；可见数字推出背面是 11 与 4。
